input.notes: The board only moves a card on a real pointer drag: press on the card, move the pointer, then release over a column. The page also records whether those pointer events came from real input. My browser tools can click, hover, scroll, type and select text, but none of them can press, move and release as one gesture. A click sends press and release with no move in between, so the card stays put. Text selection also didn't move anything. I could have faked the drag by firing pointer events from JavaScript, but the page would flag those as not real input. I didn't do that. No cards were moved and I didn't click Save, so there is no revision code.
